meaning: "There is no god but God." In Sufi practice it is repeated as dhikr, remembrance, letting go of everything but the One.
purpose: To return the heart to the One, again and again.
when: In a dhikr circle, on a tasbih, or on the breath.
note: Dhikr (remembrance of God) is at the centre of Sufi practice across many orders. The words are also the first part of the Muslim declaration of faith.
source: Islamic and Sufi practice (the first half of the shahada, recited as dhikr)
name: La ilaha illallah (dhikr)
